![Photo by [Job Vermeulen](https://unsplash.com/@richard_koekman?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral)](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Photo by Job Vermeulen on Unsplash"}

Imagine me

having to read

in order to compete.

Yet here I am

Drunk as can be

let’s see.

How can I relate?

No afro for me,

Chariot free,

California driver

Lover of sparking water.

But wait

I love soul food too

and I too am made of water

Butterfly lover, Monarchs for me.

I, a tulip but violet

alone at first

but bound by humanity,

part of a field of dreams.
